answers.text: Rebuilt them and settled Israelites there

questions.question: What did King Solomon do with the Hittites, Amorites and other non-Israelites still left in the land?

answers.text: Sent them out of the land
Gave them land of their own

questions.question: Why did Solomon say his wife, Pharaoh's daughter, must not live in the house of King David?

answers.text: The places the ark had entered were holy
The house of David belonged to the priests
The house of David was too small for her
